resources.string: Lets the paired phone type into the text field that is selected on the TV, press Back or Home, and put the TV to sleep. It looks for the text field only when the phone types.
Live view for the phone remote
Scan with your phone\'s camera and open the link, then Add to Home Screen. It works from anywhere.
The code is hidden. Show it to pair another phone.
Scan with a phone on the same Wi-Fi as this TV and open the link.\n\nFor use from anywhere and notifications, set up a relay: press Relay setup.
Scan the code and press Deploy to Cloudflare (a free account is enough). Note the address it gives you: https://tv-remote.<name>.workers.dev
On a computer with ADB, from the cleanyourtv folder, run:\nRELAY_URL=<that address> TV_HOST=%1$s addons/tv-remote/install.sh
This card then shows the relay\'s code. Scan it again with the phone and Add to Home Screen.
This TV is not on a network. Connect it to Wi-Fi or Ethernet for the phone to reach it.
New code. Phones paired before must scan it again.
From the phone at %1$s · press OK to close
Enter PIN to show the code
